result.summary: Verdict FINDINGS. Reviewed target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (branch feature/binary-config-serve-20260930) in a detached /tmp clone, scope: lifecycle transitions and state invariants with adversarial state-machine traces. 1 HIGH, 1 MEDIUM, 1 LOW. HIGH: a permanently failing pause/resume leaves a durable intent (coordinator.ts:828-829, :848, :859) that makes every other control op including force-destroy throw, skips the deadline check (:440-443) and suppresses reconciliation (:407), wedging the worker and its capacity slot; reproduced with local fakes. MEDIUM: pause_worker escapes terminal states (:851) and recover() then overwrites the settled reason (:420, :429-432); reproduced. LOW: cancel settles as cancelled when quiescence is unproven (:890) unlike fail/destroy. Baseline: 81 pass/0 fail over 6 lifecycle test files; probes 6 pass. Reports: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md and findings.json.
result.details: HIGH (reproduced, src/coordinator.ts): applyControl pause (:848) and resume (:859) call the provider with no absence handling, unlike cancel (:882-889 vmMissing) and destroy (:913 getWorker). step's catch (:510-517) only patches error, so intent stays durable; runControl (:828-829) then refuses any different intent before the redundant-pause early return (:832), step checks intent before the deadline (:440-443 vs :452-455), and recover skips intent-bearing workers (:407) so absence is never recorded and capacity is never freed. probe4 variant 1 (pause failing, guest alive): state running with an expired deadline still ignored, cancel and destroy both throw, guest still running. Variant 2 (paused, guest deleted out of band, resume): stuck paused/intent=resume, vm_missing never set, send_worker_message still acknowledged delivery=queued for an undeliverable dispatch, force destroy throws. MEDIUM (reproduced): pause_worker is ungated in MCP (mcp.ts:127-140) while the CLI gates it to ready/running/waiting (cli/overview.ts:277-283); completed/failed/cancelled/recovery_required all become paused with previous_state terminal, then recover() (which exempts only terminal.has(w.state), :420) relabels a stopped VM as recovery_required and replaces error ('test suite red: 3 failures' -> 'VM stopped; inspect before resuming'), after which resume is refused. LOW (code-evidenced): quiesce() 'paused' (:739-744) maps to recovery_required in fail (:785-798) and destroy (:918-926) but cancel (:890) settles cancelled with no error. Checked and not reported: MAX_QUEUE race in spawn, createWorker slug idempotency, transition same-state event suppression, documented pending-intent semantics. Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md, findings.json; logs in /workspace/.swarmforge/logs. Experiments only in /tmp (rv03t clone, probes, bun 1.4.2 toolchain); no source changes, commits or pushes.

result.followup_reason: HIGH finding needs a coordinator fix: make applyControl pause/resume detect a confirmed-absent guest (vmMissing) and settle, allow cancel/destroy to supersede a pending pause/resume intent in runControl, and stop letting the w.intent early return in recover() skip the absence check. MEDIUM: gate pause_worker against terminal states or keep the settled state authoritative in recover(). LOW: align cancel with fail/destroy on unproven quiescence.
